## 微软 FY26 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 分部分析

### 1. 收入同比增长计算

**原始数字**（来源：`press_release.txt`，Segment Revenue Constant Currency Reconciliation 表）：

| 期间 | Intelligent Cloud 收入 |
|---|---|
| Q4 FY26（三个月截至 2026/6/30） | **$39,306M** |
| Q4 FY25（三个月截至 2025/6/30） | **$29,878M** |

**计算过程**：

$$\text{同比增长率} = \frac{39{,}306 - 29{,}878}{29{,}878} = \frac{9{,}428}{29{,}878} \approx 31.55\%$$

四舍五入后为 **32%**（GAAP）；按恒定汇率口径为 **31%**（来源：`press_release.txt`："Revenue in Intelligent Cloud was $39.3 billion and increased 32% (up 31% in constant currency)"）。

---

### 2. 管理层归因（财报电话会原话）

以下为 Amy Hood 在 `transcript.txt` 位置 **~24808–25606**（Intelligent Cloud 分部讨论段）中的原话：

> *"In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. **Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity.** Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by **efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet** as well as **process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity**. **That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized.** Results also benefited from **stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value**."*

此外，Amy Hood 在展望 Q1 FY27 时补充（`transcript.txt` 位置 ~32535–32951）：

> *"In Azure, we expect revenue growth of approximately 45% in constant currency and **we remain focused on delivering efficiencies that help us bridge the gaps we see as customer demand continues to exceed supply**. Even with the strong close to Q4, **we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate**."*

**汇总归因因素**：

| # | 归因因素 |
|---|---|
| A | 客户持续超过可用容量的需求（Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity） |
| B | CPU 和 GPU 集群的效率提升（efficiency gains across CPU and GPU fleet） |
| C | 流程改进使新容量更早交付（process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity） |
| D | 季度内新增 Azure 容量被快速变现（additional in-quarter capacity quickly monetized） |
| E | 6 月商业模式调整后 GitHub Copilot 消费超预期（stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption after June pricing change） |

---

### 3. 已发生事实 vs. 前瞻性表述的区分

**判断依据**：以财报电话会中措辞的**时态和语境**为标准——描述 Q4 已实现业绩的用过去时/完成态，属于已发生事实；出现在"outlook/guidance"段落或包含"expect""remain focused""continue to expect"等前瞻性措辞的，属于前瞻性表述。

| 归因因素 | 性质 | 依据 |
|---|---|---|
| **A. 客户需求超过可用容量** | **已发生事实** | 原话用"continues to exceed"描述当前状态，且置于 Q4 业绩回顾段（`transcript.txt` ~24808），是对已发生季度的描述 |
| **B. CPU/GPU 效率提升** | **已发生事实** | 原话用"driven by efficiency gains"（过去驱动），置于 Q4 业绩归因段，描述已实现的效率改进 |
| **C. 流程改进使容量更早交付** | **已发生事实** | "process improvements to enable earlier delivery"描述 Q4 已完成的过程改进 |
| **D. 季度内新增容量被快速变现** | **已发生事实** | "was quickly monetized"为过去完成态，明确指 Q4 季度内已发生的变现 |
| **E. GitHub Copilot 消费超预期** | **已发生事实** | "Results also benefited from..."描述 Q4 已实现的结果，"following the June business model change"指已生效的 6 月调价 |

**前瞻性表述**（不在上述归因中，但管理层在同一通话中做出）：

| 表述 | 性质 | 依据 |
|---|---|---|
| "we remain focused on delivering efficiencies that help us bridge the gaps we see as customer demand continues to exceed supply" | **前瞻** | 出现在 outlook 段（`transcript.txt` ~32951），"remain focused""bridge the gaps we see"为对未来行动的承诺 |
| "we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate" | **前瞻** | 明确使用"continue to expect"，指向 FY27 上半年的加速增长预期 |
| "we expect revenue growth of approximately 45% in constant currency"（Q1 FY27 Azure 指引） | **前瞻** | 明确的定量指引 |

**核心区分逻辑**：业绩回顾段（"Next, the Intelligent Cloud segment..."开始的部分）中的所有归因均使用过去时态描述 Q4 已实现的结果，属于**已发生事实**；而 outlook 段（"Now, to the outlook..."开始的部分）使用"expect""remain focused""continue to expect"等措辞，指向未来季度，属于**前瞻性表述**。
